headline: Steamboat race and a jolt on deck
summary: With Governors Frantz and Curry and Gifford Pinchot aboard, the Mississippi leads a dozen steamers downriver, some racing. At Memphis Roosevelt speaks for a deep waterway commission. When the Fred Hartweg bumps his boat and knocks him to the deck, he wires for its license to be pulled. He also tells Beveridge joint statehood for Arizona and New Mexico cannot work.
